targets.authors: Segerstrom, S. C., Reed, R. G., & Scott, A. B.
targets.title: Intelligence and interleukin-6 in older adults: The role of repetitive thought.
targets.evidence_quote: The aim of this study was to replicate the findings of Segerstrom and colleagues (2017), that IQ moderates the relationship between RT and systemic inflammation, in a sample of larger age range, closer-to-average IQ range, and with additional pro- inflammatory biomarkers: C-reactive protein (CRP) and tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-a).
targets.outcome_quote: Results did not replicate Segerstrom et al. (2017) but suggested that crystallized intelligence and RT total reflect a cognitive system different than that of fluid intelligence, executive functioning, and RT valence.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Abstract explicitly states an overall failure to replicate. Discussion confirms that the central cognition-by-total-repetitive-thought interaction was absent. Agreement on the background cognition/IL-6 association does not override this overall verdict.
